scope.intended_use: Later separately authorized Ed25519 dependency/runtime review; no current installation

missing: Verified builder execution/source-to-binary or source-to-wheel relationship
Named risk owner and independent approval evidence
libffi exact identity, notices and version-scoped applicability
threat: Upstream/index credential compromise or malicious release could publish malicious bytes that agree with index hashes; hash pinning cannot authenticate intent or trusted builder

likelihood.rationale: No incident/base-rate/control-effectiveness data; absence of attestation neither proves compromise nor bounds probability

impact.rationale: Malicious native/Python package code could act with interpreter privileges, expose keys/receipts or falsify decisions; current read-only quarantine does not execute it

compensating_controls: Recheck exact official index and local SHA-256/size before any later separately approved installation
Keep verified archives quarantined; no source build, dependency resolution, alternate version or mirror
Independent review of release/source/license/native inventory and advisories
Future hash-pinned immutable runtime with no editable install, isolated imports, least privilege and OS-enforced no egress
Installed/native SBOM, accountable approval receipts, rollback and expiry monitoring
control_implementation_state: Static integrity/release/license checks evidenced; future runtime controls NOT_IMPLEMENTED and NOT_AUTHORIZED
residual_risk: Publisher/build compromise and omitted components remain possible; hashes, HTTPS and isolation are not equivalent to signed provenance

proposed_validity.starts: Only after real signed/independently reviewed approval; no effective dates yet
proposed_validity.ends: Earlier of explicit valid_until, 30 days or any revocation trigger; no automatic renewal

revocation_triggers: Different filename, hash, version, platform, ABI or runtime identity
Material new vulnerability, suspected tampering or publisher compromise
Trust-policy, isolation, dependency/SBOM or intended-use change
Expiry, loss of approver authority, withdrawn evidence or unmet compensating control
